name: WFP monthly update
description: How a month is closed and the plan is moved on. Each phase is dated; plan actions mark cost out of date and the chore recalculates only the marked versions.

phases.title: Load actuals (close the month)
phases.note: Load the HR extract into Actual. The process derives Actual's flags and rebuilds the By Location hierarchy, then recalculates Actual cost. WFP Load Actuals is the demo generator; in production use Load HR Assignments with the real extract.

phases.title: Freeze the plan
phases.note: Snapshot Forecast as of the close before changing it: a static copy under Non-Calculating, with the following period's Prior Fcst Snapshot pointed at it.

phases.title: Roll the period forward
phases.note: Add the new month first (Period Builder / period maintenance), then the year's opening balance before January. Estimate opening YTD only while payroll has not supplied the real figures.

entries.name: WFP Estimate Opening YTD
entries.note: Only if payroll has not supplied opening YTD.

phases.title: Change the plan
phases.note: Every action is dated from its month and marks cost out of date. Use the page for the job: Positions, People, Hire approvals, Hiring plan.

phases.title: Recalculate cost
phases.note: The chore runs every 5 minutes and recalcs only the versions marked out of date: Base, then the tax run for that version.

phases.title: Match actuals
phases.note: Match each plan TBH to the real HR position when it appears; unmatch if the link was wrong. Here 'match actuals' means the TBH ↔ HR match, not the variance reports.
